description: Complete visual QA of the 131-page Derived Categories PDF after the Verdier II.1.3.6 registered insertion: every page inspected in ordered contact sheets and the insertion locus plus its immediate neighbours inspected at 220 DPI.

scope.review_scope: All 131 pages received a contact-sheet layout review. PDF pages 36-39 received direct 220-DPI inspection; Lemma 10.4 occupies pages 37-38 and pages 36 and 39 establish clean neighbouring flow. This is visual QA, not a new whole-chapter mathematical proof audit.

render_protocol.contact_sheets: Nine ordered 4-by-4 sheets; all 131 page tiles inspected for layout and continuity.
render_protocol.text_extraction_role: No text extraction substituted for image inspection.

pages.observation: End of Proposition 10.3 and its TR proofs remains within the text block; formulas, diagram, links, header, page number, and lower margin are intact.

Lemma 10.4 begins after the preceding proof with normal vertical separation. The three equivalent conditions, displayed H-star functor, short exact sequence, decompositions, and contracting homotopy are legible and unclipped.
The H-star equivalence proof ends cleanly before Remark 10.5; the explicit non-naturality sentence is visible. Subsequent Lemmas 10.6-10.8 retain normal spacing and margins.
Continuation of Lemma 10.8 and Remarks 10.9-10.10 is complete; large displays and prose remain inside the page body with no collision or discontinuity.

full_page_overview_inspections.observation: Contents, opening definitions, diagrams, proofs, running headers, and page numbers are consistently placed; no blank, clipped, duplicated, or corrupted page is visible.
Triangulated-category and homotopy-category formulas and commutative diagrams remain within margins; dense proof pages retain intact lower edges.
The Verdier insertion on pages 37-38 and surrounding constructions flow normally; formulas, references, proof boxes, section transition, and diagrams are intact.
Filtered derived-category material, displays, and diagrams retain consistent page geometry, legible labels, and uninterrupted proof flow.
Injective and projective resolution sections show regular margins and headers; exact-sequence diagrams and long displays are complete.
Derived functor and K-projective/K-injective discussions remain readable; larger diagrams and bottom-of-page continuations are not clipped.
Derived adjunction, dimensions, and triangulated-category generators render with consistent hierarchy, complete formulas, and intact diagrams.
Compact-object, Brown representability, and Postnikov-system pages retain regular layout; wide diagrams remain inside the text area.
The final proof, two-column chapter index, and bibliography are complete. The intentionally short closing page is partially filled but not blank or corrupted.

reader_facing_limitations.description: References to chapters outside the 36-chapter build profile can display existing external-reference placeholders. The fixed-point build reports no newly unclassified undefined reference, citation, glyph, destination, or rerun warning.

claim_boundary: PASS means the stated complete rendered-page layout review and insertion-locus checks passed. It does not claim a new proof audit of every theorem or removal of every inherited editorial limitation.
